newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices rise after API draw.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices rise after API draw.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures continued their late day rally in after-hours Tuesday trade, fuelled by a report showing sharply lower U.S. crude supplies.
Weekly oil inventory data from the American Petroleum Institute (API) reported an unexpectedly high crude draw of 7.6 million barrels last week, bringing total U.S. stocks to 297.8 million.
"The stats are what drove (ACCESS) up," said one broker.
By 1732 PST, NYMEX April crude traded $20.66 a barrel, up 22 cents from the settle. About 1,550 lots changed hands and traders saw continued strength in tomorrow's day session.
Short covering and traders taking long positions could lift the contract over $21.00 Wednesday, with resistance seen at $21.29.
Heating oil futures for April traded up 0.56 cents a gallon from the daytime close of 53.34 cents as 150 lots were exchanged in after-hours discussion.
NYMEX gasoline on ACCESS traded 63.55 cents, up 0.66 cents a gallon from a settle of 62.89, with volume of 160 lots traded.
